title: Hallow tree
body:
Description

The Hallow Tree is an exclusive tree introduced in the Halloween 2023 update, and readded in the Halloween 2024 and 2025 updates. In the HW 2023 event, it can only spawn when a Halloween Meteor crashes, but in the HW 2024 event, this meteor was renamed to the Skeletal Meteor.

The Hallow Tree, not to be confused with the Bone Tree, spawns in the middle of a crater as a rib-like structure with a Hallow Eye placed within its ribs. While attached to the tree, it will fire a laser that deals consistent damage at the closest player. The Hallow Eye can be collected once the tree is chopped down. The hallow eye is worth 250 candy.

Tips

  • Bring a Healing Coil or a Fusion Coil when the meteor lands. This allows you to take breaks from the Hallow Eye's damage and continue chopping it down.
  • Hallow Trees are extremely tough. The Emberbane's special ability does not work if the tree hasn't been chopped off, although it will work once it has been chopped. A Living Axe is recommended for cutting the tree to make it easier to carry around (although you can use a Grabber) and a Tall Refined Axe is recommended for chopping the tree into smaller pieces.

Trivia

  • This tree was one of the only trees to have square logs, before it was changed to the normal cylinder log.
  • The sawed form looks like and act like refined quartz.
